Bare 'fclose( fp );' in main() (stream opened with mode "rb"): the int result is neither tested, assigned nor cast to (void). ERR33-C-EX1 lists the functions whose return may be ignored and fclose is not among them, so this is a violation as written. SUPERSEDES libcrc_full_audit_0.4.24's FP ('fgetc result is checked against EOF; an fclose failure on a read-only stream is inconsequential'): the stream's mode does not matter -- fclose() on a read stream can still fail (EBADF, EINTR, EIO on the final release) and ERR33-C-EX1 grants no read-only exemption; 'the project does not care' is what suppression/config is for (ADR-0001/0005), not an FP label.
